text:
Nora: Heads-up from QA: onboarding spike produced a weird mix of 429s and stale-cursor errors. Not pure prefetch this time.
Ben: stale-cursor? can you paste the sequence?
Nora: flow: client prefetches page N+1 while server GC'd older cursors -> server returns 410 stale cursor, client treats it like a transient error and retries full pagination, causing extra load.
Carlos: ah, so two separate failure modes colliding: token refresh storms were earlier, here it's cursor TTL + aggressive prefetch + naive retries.
Aisha: what's the sampleapp default prefetch now?
Nora: default=2 in sampleapp onboarding, but some customers override to 5 in their quickstarts.
Ben: idea: on 410 stale-cursor, client should stop retrying the same cursor and either reinitialize pagination or surface a clear error. not exponential-retry.
Carlos: agree. implement rule: if response.status==410 and body.reason=="cursor_expired" -> do not retry; instead fetch a fresh list-start and resume.
Aisha: also add a short-circuit dedupe for prefetch: if same cursor requested within 100ms return existing promise. cheap wins.
Nora: QA also noted inconsistent SDK behavior: python-sdk returns a CursorExpiredError, js-sdk currently returns generic 4xx and still retries. parity bug.
Ben: we'll align semantics: add CursorExpiredError type to all SDKs and update retry middleware to not retry that error.
Carlos: patch plan: (1) update js-sdk retry middleware, (2) add cursor-dedupe util to client core, (3) change sampleapp onboarding to prefetch=1 and backoff policy=exponential+jitter for 429s.
Aisha: for onboarding docs, add a short troubleshooting item: "Seeing 410s? likely cursor TTL mismatch; lower prefetch or reinitialize pagination." keep it succinct.
Nora: quick pseudocode for dedupe:
```
const inflight = new Map();
function fetchCursor(id){
  if (inflight.has(id)) return inflight.get(id);
  const p = realFetch(id).finally(()=> inflight.delete(id));
  inflight.set(id, p);
  return p;
}
```
Ben: add a small unit test that simulates GC'd cursors and asserts no retry loop.
Carlos: CI note: deploy-bot will schedule a staging deploy after PRs pass.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy -> staging @ 1745003000
Aisha: also consider adding a server header like `x-cursor-ttl` to make debugging easier for clients. small server change but helps.
Nora: agree, file a tiny API proposal and mark it opt-in for now.
Ben: timeline? I can land SDK changes this morning if no objections.
Carlos: no objections. I'll update sampleapp defaults and add debug flags to emit `cursor_event` metrics.
Aisha: I'll update docs and the migration note in changelog for parity change.
Nora: thanks. QA will re-run the onboarding stress test after deploy and post results here.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Nora: after the staging deploy, QA saw 92% fewer 410->retry cascades and overall request tail latency improved. will upload traces in a follow-up.
